investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Summitcrest Labs (collaboration SaaS); Platform: on-premises data center DC-Central, server range 172.22.0.0/16; Database: mysql server workspace-db-01 reachable from the application network only through firewall policy DB-TIER on fw-04; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
